column3: “Jesus” and “those in attendance” supply the referents; bread is omitted.
“Jesus” supplies the subject; banquet renders supper.
“Jesus” supplies the referent; “at the feast” replaces bread.
“Everything” matches the Textus Receptus (πάντα); the critical text has only “it is ready.”
“One after another” renders with one accord.
The sentence about many called and few chosen is omitted.
The two clauses are combined into one sentence.
